rationale: AOUT has gapped 27% on 33x relative volume with no available news catalyst, making the move's durability highly uncertain. With the session already in a loss and no structural edge identifiable (no catalyst, no historical comps, extended far above both VWAPs), the prudent action is to stand aside.
